content: [Conversation Summary]: A user interacted with Jarvis to adjust the layout of their screens, specifically VS Code and Microsoft Edge. The user successfully adjusted the positions of the screens, with VS Code initially being placed at the upper left position and later moved to the left and right sides. Microsoft Edge was also adjusted to the upper right and right sides of the screen, with the assistant noting that it was already at these positions in some cases.
Adjust my current screen to upper left. Upper left?
Current screen is now at the upper left. Yes, upper left.
Tanscribe in Microsoft Edge tab to bottom right.
Microsoft Edge tab is now at the bottom right.
Adjust the current screen to bottom right.
Current screen is now at the bottom right.
Adjust the current screen to upper left.
Current screen is now at the upper left position.
Adjust the current screen to upper right.
Current screen is now at the upper right.
